newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-WOOSNAM LEADS BRITISH PGA BY ONE.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-WOOSNAM LEADS BRITISH PGA BY ONE.

text.p: Ian Woosnam battled bumpy greens and clung to a one shot lead with a two-under-par 70 in the third round of the British PGA championship on Sunday.
The Welsh Ryder Cup player had an 11-under-par total of 205 to lead from Ireland's Darren Clarke, who matched his opening 66 to hold second place.
South African Ernie Els with a two-eagle 67 and Nick Faldo, 70, shared third spot on 207.
Stephen Ames of Trinidad would have joined them but for a two-shot penalty on the 12th green.

His ball moved on address but he did not realise it and did not replace it. Referee John Paramor reviewed the incident with Ames on a video tape after the round and Ames agreed that the ball had moved.
That was a penalty of one stroke and he incurred the second for not replacing the ball to its original ppsition.
His 70 left him joint fifth on seven-under with English Ryder Cup player David Gilford, who carded a 72.
European number one Colin Montgomerie soared to a 76 and fell out of contention after blocking several tee shots to the right.
